# Gorham Pullen & Odette Pullen

- [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md) — Saved — [Gorham Pullen](../character/gorham-pullen.md) — since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)</sub>
- [Gorham Pullen](../character/gorham-pullen.md) — Relative of — [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md) — family · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 ch.Time P6](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0006)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) discovers her missing amethyst brooch tangled in her black lace shawl and realizes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) was innocent after all. She confronts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), who admits she invented a false confession just so she could go to the picnic. Remorseful, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) forgives [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and sends her off to the picnic, where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) enjoys tea, ice cream, and a boat ride on the lake.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P56](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0056), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P59](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0059), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P60](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0060), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062)_

> Following the end of the school term, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visits [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) and meets his father, [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md), who has unexpectedly arrived. [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) asks [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to inquire if he may visit [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), prompting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to deliver the request to a pale [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and post the letter.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P20](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0020), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P39](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0039)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) feeling melancholic about her broken engagement and lost youth. She visits neighbors and friends, learning about recent local developments, wedding announcements, and births, which heightens her sense of loneliness.
>
